instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React JSX (.js files) as indicated by the project configuration.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes matching the listed conventions.
Implement real live progress reporting during verification step by step.
Include fallback mock verification logic if Tavily key or backend API encounters network delay, ensuring zero screen freezes.
Format source publication dates clearly and make external links open safely in a new tab.
Ensure total dark mode consistency: background #0B0F17, surfaces #111827, borders rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
